About the job
Vaartsluis Foods makes chilled ready meals, soups and salads for supermarkets in the Benelux, Germany and the UK. With 2,100 colleagues in six plants in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany we generated revenues of EUR 780 million in 2025.

Our procurement team of 28 people buys everything from vegetables and packaging to cleaning services and forklifts. Our Category Manager for indirect spend is going on maternity leave in November, and we are looking for an experienced interim professional who can take over the categories from day one.

What you will own
- The category strategies for facility services, MRO, logistics services and warehousing, and temporary labour, with an addressable spend of around EUR 140 million
- Tenders and negotiations for the framework agreements expiring in 2027, including the national cleaning contract and the road freight tender for our Dutch and Belgian plants
- The 2027 savings target of EUR 3.2 million for indirect spend, including savings tracking with Finance
- Supplier performance and relationship management with the top 15 indirect suppliers
- Spend analysis and category dashboards in Power BI
- Working with the plant managers and the S2P team to improve buying channels and catalogue compliance in Coupa
- Collecting supplier sustainability data for our CSRD reporting together with the sustainability team

What you bring
- 8+ years in indirect procurement or category management, ideally in food or FMCG manufacturing
- A track record of running complex tenders and delivering measurable savings
- Experience with e-sourcing and source-to-pay tools, preferably Coupa or SAP Ariba
- Strong analytical skills and confidence in working with plant management and the leadership team
- Fluent English; Dutch is a plus but not a requirement

Assignment details
- Interim assignment from 2 November 2026 to 30 April 2027, extension possible
- Day rate: EUR 950, all-in, excluding VAT
- Freelance (ZZP) contract or a contract with your own company
- Hybrid: two days per week in our office in Amsterdam-Sloterdijk, the other days remote
- Occasional visits to our plants in Breda, Ghent and Kleve

About us
We believe good food should be easy. Every day more than 900,000 meals leave our plants. We are a proud member of the Dutch Food Waste Alliance and have halved our food waste since 2020.
